name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-tutorial-connect-to-sharepoint-data
title: Lists and items on a site
shortDescription: The tutorial project that shows the lists on a SharePoint site, and the items in the list the user selects, from a site URL the agent passes to the tool.
longDescription: The finished project for the tutorial Connect your Copilot UX component to SharePoint data. It's the my-copilot-app project from Build your first SharePoint Copilot App with the tutorial changes applied.

The agent passes a site URL to the MyCopilotAppTool tool in the siteUrl parameter. The MyCopilotApp component uses spHttpClient to show the lists on that site and the first 25 items of the list the user selects. It handles a missing URL, a URL that isn't a site, a site the user can't access, and a site that doesn't exist. The component uses no framework, and all code runs in the browser.
